title: Black Trump
author: George R. R. Martin
note: conf=0.95; Confirmed as volume 15 of the Wild Cards shared-universe series edited by George R.R. Martin (Baen, 1995). It is a mosaic/braided novel with contributions by Stephen Leigh, Victor Milán, John J. Miller, Sage Walker and Martin; Martin is credited as editor and is the metadata author. It is the third book of the "Card Sharks" triad (vols. 13-15, "Book III of a New Cycle"), but the standard catalogued numbering is Wild Cards #15. Note: the 2025 Bantam reprint retitled the book "Showdown"; the canonical/original title for this file is Black Trump.
